title: Disable MSI for Nouveau driver
summary: Append a kernel parameter to disable Message Signaled Interrupts (MSI) if the Nouveau module fails to load or X server fails to start.

steps.explain: Edit your bootloader config (e.g., /etc/default/grub) and add 'nouveau.config=NvMSI=0' to the kernel command line, then update bootloader.

rollback.explain: Remove 'nouveau.config=NvMSI=0' from kernel parameters and update bootloader.
